name: org_graph_move_unit
description: Move a unit in the Org Graph beneath another live unit of a kind its own kind can sit under, or to the top when parent_id is omitted and its kind can sit there, from effective_on (today by default). Only a unit Espalia holds can be moved here. Moving a unit changes who inherits its ownership, so the caller needs rights on the unit and where it lands. To move a unit between structures (into a unit's own structure, out of one into the organisation's, or between two), pass conversion: a type of the structure it joins for each type the unit and those beneath it hold. Each changes type in the same change, and a unit with a structure of its own takes it along, nested. That needs the right to change both structures, which a tenant admin or an Org Graph editor holds for any structure, and an owner of a unit, or anyone above them in the reporting line, holds for the structures that unit or one beneath it declares.

plan_id.description: the plan whose change this applies. Refused unless you may apply that plan's changes

plan_change_id.description: the plan change this applies; needs plan_id

cause_id.description: groups this with the plan's other changes, to change back together; needs plan_id

conversion.description: each level_id the unit or a unit beneath it holds => the level_id it becomes, a type of the structure it moves into
